source.citation: K. Otsuka and X. Ren, Physical metallurgy of Ti-Ni-based shape memory alloys, Progress in Materials Science 50 (2005) 511-678, Table 7.
source.fraction_citation: Y.M. Jin and G.J. Weng, A direct method for the crystallography of martensitic transformation and its application to TiNi and AuCd, Acta Materialia 50 (2002) 2967-2987, Table 5.
source.input_provenance: The canonical B2/B19' lattice state and correspondence are identical to bhattacharya_niti_twin_habit_v1.
source.output_semantics: The physical habit oracle stores a unit habit normal, a unit direction of shape strain, and a separate shape-strain magnitude. The physical rank-one vector b is reconstructed as magnitude times unit direction; a unit direction is never stored or compared as b.

blind_protocol: Only crystallographic input is supplied to twin_app. Published family, fraction and physical habit quantities are read after calculation.
notes: Direction and magnitude are deliberately separate fields.
One common proper cubic symmetry operation is allowed when comparing b tensor m.
Published values are validation oracles only and are never runtime answers.

lock.mutation_policy: immutable_v1; source/convention correction requires a new benchmark id/version
